proposed_widenings.name: DamageType — chosen_at_cast_from_set
proposed_widenings.justification: The caster picks the damage type (Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Poison, or Thunder) at cast time from a closed set. DamageType is a closed string literal union; there is no variant expressing 'player-chosen at cast from enumerated options.' Encoding any fixed type would misrepresent the spell.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Choose Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Poison, or Thunder for the type of orb you create, and then make a ranged spell attack against the target.

proposed_widenings.name: matching_dice_window
proposed_widenings.justification: The leap fires when two or more d8s in the damage roll show the same face. This is a conditional trigger on the result pattern of rolled dice (matching faces among a set of dice), not representable as any existing v4 window atom (on_hit_window, post_roll_window, save_gate, reaction_window, etc.).
proposed_widenings.evidence: If you roll the same number on two or more of the d8s, the orb leaps to a different target of your choice within 30 feet of the target.

proposed_widenings.name: spell_leap_chain
proposed_widenings.justification: The leap spawns a fresh attack roll and a fresh damage roll against a secondary target — and can repeat up to [slot level] times. The current surface has no subgraph for a conditional, repeatable, slot-count-capped spell attack chain. Cleave's grant_weapon_attack is close in shape but is a mastery rider against a known weapon, not a re-rolled spell attack.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Make an attack roll against the new target, and make a new damage roll. The orb can't leap again unless you cast the spell with a level 2+ spell slot. / The orb can leap a maximum number of times equal to the level of the slot expended.

proposed_widenings.name: UsageLimit — unique_target_per_cast
proposed_widenings.justification: Higher-level casting adds a constraint that each creature can only be targeted once per casting. No existing UsageLimit or attachment filter represents a per-casting unique-target requirement. The current MasteryUsageLimit only has once_per_turn.
proposed_widenings.evidence: a creature can be targeted only once by each casting of this spell

proposed_widenings.name: SlotScaling — leap_count_equals_slot_level
proposed_widenings.justification: The maximum leap count equals the slot level expended (not base + per-slot-above-base). No existing scaling shape captures 'max invocations = slot level' as a direct equality rather than an additive increment.
proposed_widenings.evidence: The orb can leap a maximum number of times equal to the level of the slot expended

notes: The primary attack-roll + 3d8 damage mechanic is encodable as an activation/attack_roll phase with linear_per_level (axis=slot) scaling. However two blockers make honest encoding impossible: (1) DamageType has no chosen-at-cast variant — picking any fixed type falsifies the spell; (2) the matching-dice leap trigger requires a new window atom not in v4. The higher-slot leap chain and unique-target constraint add further surface and atom gaps. Classification is atom_widening (the matching-dice window is the decisive absent atom; the damage-type choice alone would be surface_widening). No dhall/json/trace produced.
